about: Guard set for the intent 'answer' (design of 27 Nov 2026). expect 'answer': a concept question the model may call answer, and checkReading must leave it as answer. expect 'search': a message that asks for evidence, which checkReading must turn into search even when the model said answer. Tests the rules around the model, not the model; the model's own accuracy needs a recorded run (npm run eval:record). None of these is an example of UNDERSTAND_SYSTEM.
